definitions.explanation: The manner in which something is written.

examples.japanese: この{文章|ぶんしょう}は{難|むずか}しい。
{文章|ぶんしょう}を{読|よ}んで{答|こた}えてください。
examples.english: Please read the passage and answer.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{文章|ぶんしょう}は{読|よ}みやすい。
examples.english: Her writing style is easy to read.

examples.japanese: もっと{分|わ}かりやすい{文章|ぶんしょう}を{書|か}くように{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I try to write in a more understandable style.

examples.japanese: この{作家|さっか}の{文章|ぶんしょう}は{独特|どくとく}で、{一度|いちど}{読|よ}んだら{忘|わす}れられない。
examples.english: This author's writing style is unique and unforgettable once you've read it.

notes:
{文章|ぶんしょう} refers to written text, passages, or writing style.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
{文|ぶん} (writing, sentence) + {章|しょう} (chapter, section)

HIERARCHY OF TEXT:
- {字|じ}: character
- {語|ご}/{単語|たんご}: word
- {文|ぶん}: sentence
- {文章|ぶんしょう}: text/passage
- {段落|だんらく}: paragraph

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {文章|ぶんしょう}を{書|か}く: to write text
- {文章|ぶんしょう}を{読|よ}む: to read a passage
- {文章|ぶんしょう}{力|りょく}: writing ability
- {文章|ぶんしょう}{構成|こうせい}: text structure

RELATED WORDS:
- {作文|さくぶん}: composition, essay
- {論文|ろんぶん}: thesis, paper
- {文体|ぶんたい}: writing style
